author: Mintu Community

ai_rules: In Next.js App Router, default to Server Components for data fetching; only add 'use client' when client interactivity, state, or browser APIs are required.

name: Supabase & PostgreSQL Pro
author: Mintu Community
description: Row Level Security (RLS) policies, PostgreSQL triggers and functions, typed Supabase client boilerplate, and REST testing templates.
ai_rules: Always enable Row Level Security (ALTER TABLE table_name ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY) on public tables and write explicit policies for select, insert, update, and delete.
Never expose service_role private keys to frontend client code; keep elevated operations in protected server handlers.
Always use parameterized queries or the Supabase SDK query builder to eliminate SQL injection vulnerabilities.

snippets.label: Postgres RLS Owner Policy
snippets.body:
-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Create Owner Policy
CREATE POLICY "Users can manage their own profile"
ON profiles FOR ALL
TO authenticated
USING ((select auth.uid()) = user_id)
WITH CHECK ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);

name: 2D Canvas & Game Engine Kit
author: Mintu Community
description: HTML5 Canvas 60 FPS game loop, sprite sheet animation manager, AABB collision detection, spatial math, and asset bundle commands.
ai_rules: In canvas and game loops, avoid object allocations (new Vector, new Array) inside requestAnimationFrame render loops to eliminate garbage collection frame drops.
Use delta time (dt in seconds) for all physics and movement calculations to ensure framerate-independent gameplay.
Clean up event listeners and cancel requestAnimationFrame handles when destroying game viewports.
